summary: PrS 32/9 is the same bear-suspension passage already quoted as prs 80/8. Orthographic and numbering differences do not make it a new example.

Feminine mzalzaqto agrees with the bear and follows fayišo to predicate a resulting suspension state. Retain the inherited Detransitive Part. Pass. and D1; neither an active sense nor a new event sense is established.
The inherited base forms and etymology are preserved. The supplied evidence does not independently test them.
Remove the duplicated pronoun before er sie
before: dann stiess sie er sie hinab
rationale: The sequence sie er sie contains an extra pronoun and is ungrammatical. The surrounding sentence and Turoyo tfəqole describe him pushing the she-bear down; retain er as subject and sie as object.
